Revenue by category — monthly

Jan 2024 net loss is misleading. The reported $662K net loss in Jan 2024 is driven almost entirely by one-time legacy clean-up entries booked that month: bad debt write-off of $984K, asset impairment of $142K, and FX revaluation of $187K. Stripping those out, real Jan 2024 operating performance was roughly $50K profit ($287K revenue, $82K COGS, ~$152K opex). The prior-year clean-up was booked in Jan instead of restating prior periods.

Why runway does not extend even with expected inflows

Cash today $8.5K, committed burn $14.8K/month. Pure current-ops runway is under 4 weeks.
Must-pay arrears ~$143K. Payroll arrears ($123K) carry personal director liability in Kenya. PAYE/NSSF/NHIF arrears ($15K) and KRA payment plan ($6K) are statutory and senior. These do not go away by not paying them — they accrue penalties.
Expected inflows next 60 days ~$43K (Tembelea $5K + Brenda $2K + Clarivate $6K + Zana $30K). If we paid only current burn and zero arrears, that extends runway by ~9 weeks. In practice some arrears must be settled, so the realistic extension is ~3-4 weeks.
Bottom line. Inflows do not buy us runway. They buy us a chance to settle priority arrears and exit cleanly. The only meaningful runway lever is bulk-sale of remaining inventory (butterflies) which is independent of the Tembelea/Zana timeline.

What this means

Insolvent on any reasonable measure. Unsecured liabilities ~$300K against recoverable asset pool of $160K to $220K, before the AlphaMundi secured claim.
AlphaMundi has consented to the Tembelea platform sale. Their secured position is being monetised via Tembelea rather than enforcement, which protects residual value for the rest of the creditor table.
Payroll arrears $123K is the biggest personal-liability item. Kenya labor law gives statutory protection to employees; director can be personally pursued for unpaid wages, PAYE, and NSSF.
AfyaNzima AR of $75K is effectively zero. The container clinic was sold to Dawa Pharmaceuticals and other PaaS clinic assets have been written off. The intercompany AR is non-recoverable.
Inventory is the only meaningful disposal asset. Best route: single distributor bulk sale, not 1 device per month at current channel rate. Tony's serial-numbered count in progress.

Why some Xero numbers don't match the operating system

After October 2025, Xero books stopped being maintained day-to-day. Bank uploads, revenue recognition, and supplier invoices continued in the operating system (used by Loise for daily treasury and AR work) but did not flow back to Xero. For balance sheet items dated after Oct 2025, the operating system numbers are the authoritative ones. The Real Balance Sheet view on the Wind-Down tab reflects this reconciliation.
